This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 27-01-2026 (the "Effective Date") by and
between Docupath Solutions Lda, with its registered office at Avenida da Liberdade 50, Porto ("Party A"), and Lusitana
Ferramentas Lda, with its registered office at Rua Augusta 100, Porto ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 24 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in
accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the
purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.
